note: Companies approaching the market that are NOT yet trading. An entry here carries no traded price: offer_price is an offer price only, and a null means the offer terms are not yet established. These rows must never be rendered on a price, heatmap, screener or candle board, because a missing price renders as a zero and a zero is a lie about a company that has not traded. Each entry carries a provisional key: it is NOT a published ticker, must never be shown as a symbol, and exists only to look the row up.
